svg.aria-label: Vector Search Engine: Search by meaning, every index written by hand. Exact search + HNSW in NumPy, no FAISS or hnswlib; recall within 0.004 of hnswlib. 0.98 recall@10 at 0.52 ms on 120k embeddings, 16.6× faster than exact search. Same eval vs a pure-Python HNSW: recall@10 0.91 vs 0.62, ~34× faster. Stack: Python, NumPy, sentence-transformers.
